title: USAID former headquarters at Ronald Reagan Building
summary: A current USAID OIG page identifies USAID OIG Headquarters at the Ronald Reagan Building, 1300 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington, D.C. 20523. Because USAID's independent operating structure was dismantled and functions transferred to State, this packet preserves the address as USAID's former agency headquarters rather than asserting a current independent-agency headquarters.

sources.title: Office of Inspector General Student Internship Program
